entries.22846183d3d93e08: A company that manufactures and sells secondary concrete products, supplying civil engineering materials, landscape materials and exterior products for housing to public works projects and private housing.
entries.762f2993e75b0967: The company manufactures and sells concrete products for waterways, roads, agriculture and forestry, and sewerage, such as box culverts, Hume pipes, heavy-duty pipes and L-shaped retaining walls, for public works. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,778 million, making it the largest business, accounting for more than 7 tenths of the total. The consolidated subsidiary Hazuki Kogyo Co., Ltd. carries out slope protection work. The Takamatsu Plant, Tokushima Plant, Yanahara Plant, Hyogo Plant and Ibaraki Plant are the production facilities for this business.
entries.7f9d41d6189dec2a: For private housing, the company manufactures and sells residential exterior products, mainly standing water taps, along with garden products, decorative blocks and gate posts.
entries.b15dd0b78461a82d: For public spaces such as sidewalks and parks, the company manufactures and sells concrete paving materials, curbstones, stair blocks, imitation wood and imitation stone.
